name: Minicraft
author: TheFloatingPixel
description: A semi-open-world sandbox: gather, craft and build on a random 50x50 map, then save at the campfire. X uses the item, Z opens the inventory; mouse works too.

descriptions.en: A semi-open-world sandbox: gather, craft and build on a random 50x50 map, then save at the campfire. X uses the item, Z opens the inventory; mouse works too.
descriptions.it: Un sandbox semi-open world: raccogli, crea e costruisci su una mappa casuale 50x50, poi salva al falò. X usa l'oggetto, Z apre l'inventario; funziona anche col mouse.
